verdict.rationale: Exporting account data in open formats is a fair question for a hosting platform that stores forms, blobs, databases and site configuration, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented data-export capability. The REST API and CLI are only building blocks for programmatic management, the `.md` versions of docs pages are documentation rather than user data, and community reports of migrating away describe users leaving, not a product export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
